description: Needs student-ok (confirm:true OR elicitation) after the user asked for this staff view. ADR 0060: reads ADAM's "Members" view, which ILIAS only offers to tutors and course admins; a student gets forbidden (not a missing object). Returns other people's display names and logins (email-shaped logins redacted) — personal data. Read-only: follows only the tab ADAM itself advertises, never submits the view's save/mail forms, never changes grades or memberships. evidence is "lab-verified": the parser is built from ILIAS 10.12 lab markup and fails closed (provider_unavailable) when ADAM's markup differs. Confirm contract: pass confirm:true OR approve elicitation; hosts without elicitation require confirm:true; decline/cancel → same confirmation_required, no data; forum needs gate only with threadId. Recipe: {"refId":"...","confirm":true}.

confirm.description: Optional gate. Set true only after the user (a tutor or course admin) asked for this staff view. Returns other people's names, logins and grade status, so it is personal data. Confirm contract: pass confirm:true OR approve elicitation; hosts without elicitation require confirm:true; decline/cancel → same confirmation_required, no data; forum needs gate only with threadId. Recipe: {"refId":"...","confirm":true}.

refId.description: ILIAS ref_id: digits, adam://{type}/{id}, or https://adam.unibas.ch/go/{type}/{id}. Titles and non-ADAM URLs are rejected.

type.description: Optional object type from a prior listing/search hit (crs, fold, file, exc, …). Pass the hit's type; never invent types. Prefer this so the server opens /go/{type}/{refId}. If explicit type disagrees with refId, the call fails on typed getters (adam_get_course, adam_get_file, adam_get_exercise, adam_get_forum) — run `adam_search` and pass the hit's `type+refId`. Page and listing reads treat type as a hint and return the resolved type.
